note.limitBannerUrgent_one: Only 1 character left — more text may be cut.
note.limitBannerUrgent_other: Only {{count}} characters left — more text may be cut.
note.limitBannerFull: Limit reached for this {{noun}}. Shorten some text to continue.
note.previewPlaceholderNote: Tap the mic to dictate a note
note.previewPlaceholderJournal: Tap the mic to dictate today's journal
note.editNoteHint: Opens the keyboard to type or correct text
note.dictationHintTruncatedNote: Note is at the character limit — some dictation was cut.
note.dictationHintTruncatedJournal: Journal is at the character limit — some dictation was cut.
note.dictateHint: Long press to open and edit without dictating

dictation.webOnly: Dictation works in the phone app, not in the browser.
dictation.moduleMissing: Dictation needs a newer app install. Update Life Dashboard from the latest development APK.
dictation.notAvailable: On-device speech recognition is not available on this phone.
dictation.installOnDevice: Dictation needs on-device speech (Android System Intelligence) with an offline voice model. Install that on this phone, download English and/or French for offline use, then try again. Life Dashboard does not use cloud speech.
dictation.micLifeApp: Allow Microphone for Life Dashboard: Settings → Apps → Life Dashboard → Permissions → Microphone.
dictation.micBoth: Allow Microphone for Life Dashboard (Settings → Apps → Life Dashboard → Permissions), then try again.
dictation.offlineModel: Download the offline voice model in the system dialog, then try dictation again. For mixed English and French in one note, download both languages.
dictation.offlineCanceled: Offline voice model download was canceled. Download your language for offline speech, then try again.
dictation.timedOut: Speech recognition took too long to start. Check Microphone permission for Life Dashboard, then try again.
dictation.unavailable: Could not start on-device speech recognition. Check that Android System Intelligence is installed and that Microphone is allowed for Life Dashboard.
dictation.language: This language is not available for offline speech. Download English and/or French for on-device use, then try again.
dictation.network: Offline speech isn’t ready. Download your language for on-device speech, then try again. Life Dashboard does not use cloud speech.
dictation.busy: Speech recognition is busy. Wait a moment, then try again.
dictation.generic: Could not transcribe. Check Microphone permission for Life Dashboard, then try again.
dictation.iosOnDevice: On-device speech recognition is not available. Enable Dictation in iOS Settings → General → Keyboard.
